head: codex/original-reservation-readback-20261012
title: fix: reconcile original reservation guard failures without retry or authority
body:
Actual natural recovery roles38192548280,38192548233 and38192548264 on main5694af9030cb550653d655d0abbd63468d0ea196 reached the writer and failed with Lambda200/Unhandled/ValueError/INTERRUPTED_RECOVERY_FAILURE_TERMINAL_NULL_ONLY. The original row guard combines state, original identity, merge binding and existing terminal fields; the failing subcondition is still unverified. This is a distinct follow-up to merged PR2664 diagnostics, not a replay of that PR or an endpoint change from PR2665.

On exactly that internally generated failed read, perform one DISTINCT existing signed READ_MERGED_RECOVERY_CONTEXT operation. The existing writer uses ConsistentRead=True for its original reservation lookup. Retain only a fixed allowlisted context state and verified write_performed=false in the existing HOLD artifact; reject unknown states or non-false write claims. Preserve the FIRST error and rethrow it even if readback succeeds. A second read failure has its own safe diagnostic. Never retry the failed action or proceed to approval, consume, finalizer or promotion. No raw row, terminal, approval signature, payload or environment is retained. No writer/server deployment, permissions, IAM, triggers, endpoints or security policy changes.

Validation:262 related interrupted/postmerge tests passed; independent Red Team30 client tests passed, including exact-fault-only two-distinct-read flow, wrong fault/other operation no follow-up, invalid readback withholding, sensitive output exclusion, first-error retention and actual CLI HOLD artifact/nonzero exit. Native exact-head CI is pending. These tests do not establish the live row state or immutable terminal. The deployed writer CodeSha256, exact row subcondition, original immutable terminal and full natural authority remain unverified. Two successful Sentinel observers share one producer generation and are not two distinct natural generations.

Rollback: revert this bounded client/receipt/test delta. Existing mission receipt: https://github.com/johnkim9524-collab/kaios_enterprise_repo/pull/2659#issuecomment-6109874950 . Draft creation does not grant Ready/merge/runtime authority. autonomous_effect=read-only native reconciliation after a verified rejection; global_effect=unchanged producer coverage and bounded extra read; irreplaceable_value_effect=preserve original reservation and no-reconsume; transparency_effect=retain first failure separately from observed context. Production/Public/G5/provider HOLD.
